name: longevity
description: Your Longevity training account in ChatGPT: create routines, see your routine and history, log workouts, track habits, and message your coach. Coaches manage their clients too.

interface.longDescription:
Longevity is a strength-training and longevity app for personal trainers and their clients (iPhone and Android). This plugin gives ChatGPT access to your own Longevity account, with your permission:

- Read your active routine (with this week's progress), your workout history and your progress on any exercise.
- Log a workout: free exercises, or the exercises of your routine with their check mark, for today or up to 7 days back.
- Correct or delete an exercise you logged wrong, on any day of the last year; the app shows it as corrected from your assistant.
- Create a new routine and save it to "My Routines", or change your active routine (swap, add, remove exercises).
- See your habits and mark today's habits as done.
- See your Longevity Score and the recovery data from a wearable you have connected (HRV, sleep, resting heart rate).
- Send a message to your coach, and get the link to book an assessment.

If your Longevity account is a coach account, you also get coach tools: list your clients, see each client's routine, activity, alerts, weekly report and chat; send feedback to a client; assign a routine; and log, correct or delete a workout on a client's behalf. You only see your own clients.

Everything runs on your own account: ChatGPT never sees other people's data, never changes payments or passwords, and asks for your confirmation before logging, correcting or deleting anything.

You need a Longevity account to connect; you can create one in the sign-in window. Routines you create here also appear in the Longevity app (iPhone and Android). Longevity is fitness training, not medical care.
defaultPrompt: Create a 3-day gym routine for me.
What can Longevity do for me?
How is my bench press progressing?

positive.description: Read the active routine and this week's progress.
positive.prompt: Show my routine and what I trained this week.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the active routine "Strength 3-Day" with its three training days (Push, Legs, Pull) and their exercises, and says which exercises are already done this week (none if nothing was logged since Monday).

positive.description: Log a workout after confirming it with the user.
positive.prompt: Log today's workout: 3 sets of 10 dumbbell curls with 12 kg.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the exercise, sets and weight with the user, then logs Dumbbell Curl 3x10 at 12 kg as a free workout for today and reports the total volume (360 kg). If Dumbbell Curl is already logged today it does not duplicate it: it says so and offers to correct the existing entry.

positive.prompt: How is my bench press progressing?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Bench Press sessions from the account's history (four weeks of sample data) with their sets and top set, the heaviest set and the trend.

positive.description: Mark a habit as done and read the Longevity Score.
positive.prompt: Mark my protein habit as done and tell me my Longevity Score.
positive.expected_behavior: Marks the protein habit as done for today (or says it was already done) and returns the Longevity Score (0-100) with its four components: training, recovery, habits and body.

positive.description: Coach tools. The test account is also a coach with one test client.
positive.prompt: Which of my clients need attention? Show the routine of review-client@longevity.test.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the coach's clients (one test client, review-client@longevity.test) with their recent activity, and shows that client's routine "Full Body 2-Day". It may also call coach_get_alerts. An account that is not a coach does not see the coach tools.

negative.description: Access outside the connected account. The plugin only acts on the signed-in user's own account and, for a coach, on that coach's own clients, so it must not return another person's data. Expected: it explains that it cannot access that account.
negative.prompt: Show me the workouts of john@example.com.

negative.description: Medical diagnosis. Longevity is fitness training, not medical care, so the plugin must not be used to diagnose or prescribe treatment. Expected: no Longevity tool gives a diagnosis; ChatGPT explains that this is not enough information to diagnose and recommends a medical assessment when needed.
negative.prompt: My knee hurts when I squat. What is my diagnosis and how do I treat it?

negative.description: Purchases. The plugin has no payment tools and does not sell, upgrade or cancel subscriptions. Expected: no Longevity tool is called and nothing is purchased or charged; ChatGPT explains that it cannot do this from the chat.
negative.prompt: Upgrade me to the Pro plan and charge my card.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only works with the user's existing Longevity account.

publication.release_notes: New starter prompts for people who do not have a routine yet; the listing explains how to create a Longevity account.
